Crypto News is one of the top-of-mind apps for crypto enthusiasts. It is a useful solution to track everything that happens in the crypto market on a daily basis. The platform includes a news and crypto proces aggregator, as well as Hodlfolio – a portfolio manager.

All the latest news in one solution

What is the crypto industry talking about? What coins are profitable, what events have affected the market today? It is quite a challenge to keep track of everything – a huge volume of messages appear on various sources every day. Crypto News offers a convenient solution –read all the news in a single application! We collect content from the most popular sources: Cointelegraph, Coindesk, Twitter, etc.

More than 300 news websites – that’s the list of sources which is constantly being updated. You won't miss anything important! News are available in English, Russian, German, Spanish and Arabic.

The news is collected in “Categories”, and users can always customize the feed, too. The app sends push notifications when important market-influencing events occur. No time to read right now? Bookmark the news and read it later, or find important information using the search option. Plus, users can always share important news with a friend or colleague.

The new version of the app provides an option for commenting and reacting to news and events – this will help users know the opinions of the audience and better understand what is happening on the market.

CoinMarketCap: pulse of the market

The app integrates the CoinMarketCap service, providing real-time price rates for cryptocurrencies. It shows changes for 1 hour, 24 hours and 7 days; users can set up a linear display of the chart, or in the form of “candlesticks”.

The app provides data on changes in the cryptocurrency market so that Crypto News users always have relevant information about the prices of coins and tokens. Users can find a specific coin by name or ticker: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Cardano (ADA), Shiba Inu (SHIB), Solana (SOL),XRP (XRP), Terra (LUNA), Dogecoin (DOGE), Polkadot (DOT), Tether (USDT), BNB (BNB), Polygon (MATIC), Avalanche (AVAX), Cronos (CRO), Decentraland (MANA), VeChain (VET), The Sandbox (SAND), Chainlink (LINK), etc.

Also, Crypto News can notify about changes in the price of a coin, its capitalization, or changes in the share of BTC in the market – you need to set the range of changes to get alerts in time.

Hodlfolio: portfolio management

Control the value of crypto assets in different currencies and calculate their profitability! Users can fix trades by specifying buy and sell rates. The app calculates the current value of the assets in the portfolio and displays the profit or loss.

Hodlfolio displays both the overall balance and the value of each asset separately. You can select a period and calculate the profitability of holding coins. The portfolio total value can be displayed in fiat currencies and in cryptos.

Important: working with Hodlfolio does not require personal data, keys and passwords. You can specify any balance of coins – it is not necessary that it corresponds to your real account.
